statusDetail: Coverage-complete model-driven audit of the public entry, account/login entry states, a representative registration route, and recovery behavior.

page.notes: Public Indonesian government school-registration service. Representative scope excluded authenticated applicant data entry on siswa-jkt.spmb.id because it is a separate origin and would require user credentials/data.

paths.description: Public landing page and grade-route chooser; represents the primary entry surface.
Login grade-selection overlay; represents authentication entry and cancellation.
Ajuan Akun menu; represents account creation, verification, and activation entry.
SD route /010401; represents a registration-path detail, ordered journey, and internal navigation.
Unknown URL recovery probe; represents HTTP/navigation failure handling.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remains black text on transparent/light surfaces and computed color-scheme is light; the dark screenshot matches the light design.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and define dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The announcement marquee continues under reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reports the 50,000 ms marquee-f961668e animation still running while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the marquee animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and present the announcement as stationary, readable text.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not adapt to scroll position.
findings.evidence: Screenshots and CSS probes show fixed navigation and a continuously moving announcement, but no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or position-aware header behavior on long 2,228–3,118 px pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sticky chrome with a restrained scroll-state treatment or progress affordance on the long registration detail page.

findings.summary: Selection overlays are custom role=dialog structures rather than native dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: Opening Login or registration selection creates a role=dialog overlay, while the DOM contains zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal selection flows with showModal(), native focus containment, Escape handling, and close semantics.

findings.summary: Responsive components rely on viewport rules only.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container rules even though registration cards and navigation components are reused across wide and narrow layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare containment on reusable regions and use @container rules for card/navigation adaptations, retaining current viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently become a real registration route instead of showing a recoverable not-found state.
findings.evidence: Navigating to /this-route-does-not-exist ended at /010401 and displayed a valid SD registration path, with no explanation, retry, or return-home error state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 page for unknown URLs with a clear message, home link, search, and preserved navigation context.

findings.summary: The primary page loads far outside good Core Web Vitals thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 9.9 s, LCP 20.4 s, CLS 0.224, and performance 44; the trace independently measured FCP 4.03 s and LCP 8.40 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, reduce blocking CSS/JS, server-render the initial view, and retest LCP and CLS under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Late content causes substantial layout shift.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.219 with a 0.184 shift around 10.45 s; all 12 images lack complete width/height dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space with width/height or aspect-ratio and stabilise font/image loading so late API content does not move the page.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is heavy, uncompressed, and poorly cached.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 99 requests and 2.94 MB transferred; the 761 KB JS and 539 KB CSS were uncompressed, and several images lacked cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable Brotli, long immutable caching for hashed assets, remove the redirect, self-host/preload critical font assets, and shorten the critical dependency chain.

findings.summary: The page ships large amounts of unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 446 KiB unused CSS and 435 KiB unused JavaScript, including 327 KiB unused in the main bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split the application, purge unused framework/component CSS, and load analytics and route-only modules conditionally.

findings.summary: Meaningful images and linked logos lack accessible text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse image-alt failed on the linked SPMB logo; the image audit found two images without alt text, including the route illustration.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful linked images concise alt text or an accessible name; mark genuinely decorative images alt="" and remove them from links.

findings.summary: Several text/control combinations fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the Ajuan Akun button at 2.8:1 and footer/empty-state text as low as 2.56:1 against white.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken orange and muted text tokens until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text/UI boundaries reach their applicable thresholds.

findings.summary: Document landmarks and heading hierarchy are invalid.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no main landmark and a skipped heading order; DOM inspection shows H3 before H1 on home and repeated H1s plus H4/H3 jumps on /010401.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, use one descriptive H1 per page, and nest subsequent headings without skipped levels.

findings.summary: Images are unsized and frequently oversized or legacy-format.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 12/12 without complete dimensions, six oversized, eight legacy format, and four below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, modern AVIF/WebP variants, and lazy-load non-critical below-fold images.

findings.summary: Pages lack meta descriptions and route-specific titles.
findings.evidence: The DOM and Lighthouse show no meta description; the home and /010401 detail route share the same generic title.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a unique title and concise meta description for each route on the server.

findings.summary: Core content and navigation are not reliably crawlable without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 8% raw-content coverage on home and 4% on /010401 with an empty #__nuxt mount; several links use javascript: or empty href values.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core route content and emit real href URLs for every navigation/action destination.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are missing or invalid.
findings.evidence: No canonical link is present, and /sitemap.xml returns the application HTML with zero <loc> entries while robots.txt allows crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid XML sitemap, add route-specific canonical URLs, and keep robots, status codes, and canonical targets consistent.

findings.summary: The public government service exposes no structured or social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata on either the organisation home or registration detail route.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/GovernmentService and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD plus Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Security headers and analytics-cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are absent; both _ga cookies are non-Secure, SameSite=None, and live for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and set analytics cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite policy and shorter retention.

findings.summary: The page loads a large tracking and third-party footprint without visible choice.
findings.evidence: The tracker audit found 11 third-party origins and Google Analytics plus Microsoft Clarity; HAR attributes 96/99 requests and 2.92/2.94 MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, defer analytics until an appropriate consent/legal basis exists, shorten retention, and proxy or self-host essential static assets.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are mostly absent.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP frame-ancestors, or X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors (and a legacy X-Frame-Options fallback), strict Referrer-Policy, least-privilege Permissions-Policy, CSP, and nosniff.

findings.summary: The service is an empty JavaScript shell without progressive enhancement.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML contains an empty #__nuxt mount; crawler coverage is 8% on home and 4% on the primary detail route, whose content disappears without JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render essential guidance and links, then hydrate enhancements so core registration information survives script failure.

findings.summary: The app-like registration service has no manifest, service worker, or offline fallback.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no manifest and no controlling service worker on the long-lived registration SPA.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a small service worker-backed offline/error page for previously visited guidance and network failures.

findings.summary: The Indonesian-language document does not declare its language.
findings.evidence: Both home and /010401 have an empty html lang value; Lighthouse html-has-lang failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Set <html lang="id"> server-side and audit reusable CSS for logical inline/block properties and bidi-safe layout.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bandwidth.
findings.evidence: The image audit found six oversized images, eight legacy-format files, no responsive sources for key rasters, and a 493 KB image rendered around 96 px wide.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate appropriately sized AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and avoid downloading hidden carousel assets eagerly.

findings.summary: The initial load performs disproportionate third-party and analytics work.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 96 third-party requests, including analytics/Clarity, while Lighthouse identifies hundreds of KiB of unused JS/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential analytics and route code until idle, consent, or actual interaction, and remove redundant component CSS.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and fonts dominate the resource budget.
findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 2.92 MB; GTM alone transfers 153 KB and Clarity adds requests while the page’s core purpose is mostly text and navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove low-value trackers, self-host/subset the font, and cache shared assets aggressively.

findings.summary: Repeated menu interaction leaves suspicious retained heap growth.
findings.evidence: After ten open/close cycles, the heap summary grew from 21.30 MB/386,315 nodes to 25.11 MB/438,006 nodes; closures rose from 19,470 to 24,875. This is a medium-confidence leak signal, not a proven allocation trace.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the repeated toggle with baseline/target/final snapshots, identify retained listeners/closures, and clean up overlay/event resources on close.

taskList.title: Server-render core routes and correct crawl/index metadata
Fix LCP, CLS, compression, caching, and route payloads
Deploy a complete security/privacy baseline and reduce tracking
Repair language, landmarks, headings, alt text, and contrast
Respect dark mode and reduced-motion preferences
Reduce third-party and background resource waste
Use native modal semantics and component queries
Investigate retained heap after repeated overlay interaction
